launch.addCommand.commandInfo: Can span several lines, run in order as if typed into a terminal, in the server's default shell.
launch.info: Collect what you start together, grouped by project, and run or stop it all at once. You can add run configurations from a project’s Run tab (the rocket button, or Choose Launch Items), scripts or executables (Add Executable, or long-press a file in the file list and choose Add to Launch), and commands you type in (Add Command).
mobile.welcome.info: On the computer you want to manage, open Lemon Paperplane, go to Settings → Servers, turn on remote access and create an access key; it shows a connection code and a QR code. On the Linux headless server run paperplane server key add <device-name>. Scan the QR code or paste the connection code here. If the server allows password sign-in you can also use an account and password.
mobile.welcome.title: Connect to your server
